data.title: Dr. Pradyuman Vaja
data.subtitle: Hon'ble Minister for Higher & Technical Education, Government of Gujarat
data.description: Introducing our esteemed Chief Guest for the 19th Convocation of Ganpat University.

body: Dr. Pradyuman Ganubhai Vaja is an esteemed leader, dedicated public servant, and medical professional serving as the Cabinet Minister for Higher & Technical Education in the Government of Gujarat.

Born in Gujarat, he completed his MBBS, DGO, and MD degrees, establishing himself as a distinguished medical practitioner before dedicating his life to public welfare, social justice, and educational transformation.

Inspired by public service, Dr. Pradyuman Ganubhai Vaja entered active politics with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He was elected as a Member of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly from the Kodinar Assembly constituency in the Gir Somnath district.
In the 2022 Gujarat Legislative Assembly elections, he achieved a decisive victory by securing 77,794 votes, defeating his nearest opponent by a historic margin of 19,386 votes.

With a rare combination of experience in medicine, law, and visionary governance, Dr. Pradyuman Ganubhai Vaja continues to steer Gujarat's higher education system towards academic excellence, industry innovation, and holistic student development.

data.title: Dr. V. Narayanan
data.subtitle: Hon'ble Chairman, Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
data.description: Introducing our esteemed Guest of Honour for the 19th Convocation of Ganpat University.

body: Dr. V. Narayanan is a world-renowned Rocket and Spacecraft Propulsion Expert serving as the Secretary of the Department of Space and Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

Joining ISRO in 1984, Dr. Narayanan has dedicated over four decades to India's space program. In the initial phase of his career at the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC), he made foundational contributions to Solid Propulsion across Sounding Rockets, ASLV, and PSLV launch vehicles.

After completing his M.Tech in Cryogenic Engineering with First Rank from IIT Kharagpur in 1989, he joined the Cryogenic Propulsion Programme at LPSC, playing a pivotal role in the development and operationalisation of indigenous cryogenic subsystems for GSLV Mk-II and GSLV Mk-III.

As Project Director of the prestigious C25 Cryogenic Project, Dr. Narayanan provided visionary techno-managerial leadership in the realization of the 25-tonne cryogenic propulsion system for GSLV Mk-III, placing India among the select group of nations possessing advanced cryogenic capability.

Dr. Narayanan played central leadership roles in flagship national missions including Chandrayaan-2, Chandrayaan-3, and the Gaganyaan Human Spaceflight Programme, delivering critical propulsion reliability for launch vehicles, landers, and crew modules.

He earned his Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering from IIT Kharagpur in 2001 and has received prestigious national accolades including the Astronautical Society of India Gold Medal, Distinguished Alumnus Award from IIT Kharagpur, and an Honorary Doctorate (D.Sc.).
data.title: Dr. V. Narayanan

data.title: Padmashri Ganpat Patel (D.Lit.)
data.subtitle: President & Patron-in-Chief, Ganpat University
data.description: The visionary founder and patron guiding the ethos of Ganpat University.

body: Padmashri Ganpat Patel (D.Lit.) is a visionary philanthropist, industrialist, and the revered President & Patron-in-Chief of Ganpat University.

Born in a rural agrarian family in Mehsana district, Gujarat, his journey from humble beginnings to founding Cherokee International in the United States exemplifies extraordinary perseverance, technical brilliance, and entrepreneurial grit.

Driven by a profound conviction that education is the ultimate catalyst for human elevation and rural prosperity, Shri Ganpatbhai Patel channeled his life's resources and global goodwill into establishing Ganpat University in 2005.

Under his visionary stewardship, Ganpat Vidyanagar has flourished into a world-class high-tech campus empowering tens of thousands of scholars with experiential learning, research excellence, and global opportunities.
In recognition of his distinguished contributions to literature and education, the Government of India conferred upon him the prestigious Padma Shri in 2019.
data.title: Padmashri Ganpat Patel (D.Lit.)

data.description: Leading the academic excellence and global initiatives of Ganpat University.

body: Prof. (Dr.) Mahendra Sharma is an eminent academician, higher education strategist, and the Joint President & Group Pro Chancellor of Ganpat University.

With over three decades of distinguished leadership across premier universities and technical institutes, Dr. Sharma has championed industry-aligned curricula, interdisciplinary research ecosystems, and international academic partnerships.

Under his academic guidance, Ganpat University has achieved stellar national accreditations, five-star state rankings, and cutting-edge centers of excellence in emerging technologies and applied sciences.

data.body:
Greetings from Ganpat University!!!
You are invited to attend the
Dear Graduating Students,

We are pleased to inform you that the 19th Convocation of Ganpat University is scheduled on 8th January 2026 at Ganpat University.
You are cordially invited to attend the Convocation Ceremony and receive your Degree/Diploma "In-Person".
Kindly confirm your presence on or before 2nd January 2026 through the convocation attendance confirmation link - Click Here

Kindly refer the website https://convocation.guni.ac.in frequently for the detailed schedule, profile of guests and guidelines for attending the 19th convocation. Still interested further to share your experiences, feedback, or photographs on Ganpat University's official Social Media platforms, please feel free to WhatsApp on (+91) 99743 38707, (+91) 99241 97787.

Female StudentsSaree of sober colour and decent design or Official/Formal Attire suiting to the occasion. [Kindly avoid Jeans, T-Shirts, etc.].
For any assistance, write to us at "convocation@ganpatuniversity.ac.in"

University Reception - (+91) 8200788446
Examination Section - (+91) 9328801750

Kindly feel free to interact with the Faculty/Institute wise Contact Numbers
appended herewith in case you have further query.
Looking forward to welcoming you to your own campus.
We are proudly endorsing you as GUNVAN (GUNI) ALUMNI.
Best Wishes

data.title: Ceremony & Robing Rules

items: Robe Collection: Get your registration and collect your Robe from the designated places at your respective institutes.
Procession Discipline: Maintain proper distance and discipline during the procession.
Seating: Occupy your pre-allocated seat at the Ceremony Venue before the procession enters the pandal. Do not move the chairs.
Parents Seating: Parents and companions will directly occupy their seats at the Venue by 03:30 PM.
Disbursal Discipline: Maintain discipline, silence, and social distancing while leaving the venue after completion of the ceremony.
Group Photo: Students shall maintain social distance before, during, and after group photos.
Experience & Dining: Capture your memories in the experience zone and have dinner at designated counters in the Dinner Zone.
